summary.intent: Review and update codebase maps, identify E2E testing gaps and infrastructure concerns, capture todos, add new roadmap phases for technical debt resolution, and begin Phase 28 context discussion.
summary.outcome: Created 6 new GSD todos for E2E testing and staging baselines, added 5 new roadmap phases (28-32) for code hygiene/observability/structural work, completed Phase 28 context discussion with logger design decision (custom wrapper over pino/browser), and filed two PRs (FSM1/cipher-box#380, FSM1/cipher-box#381). Fixed a markdownlint escaping issue that was breaking GSD tooling JSON output.

repo: AES-CTR streaming is used for media files >256KB, GCM for everything else — implemented in streaming-crypto.service.ts with Service Worker interception at /decrypt-stream/* URLs
deleteTestAccount() helper exists in tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts but only recovery.spec.ts actually calls it — 11 of 12 specs leave orphaned test accounts
00-Preliminary-R&D/poc/ contains 89MB of committed node_modules and deprecated ipfs-http-client@60.0.1 — fully superseded by production SDK, safe to delete
Web app has 139 console.* calls across 29 files; hooks.ts alone has 34 (Web3Auth debug logging leaking SDK state)
Pino browser mode lacks redaction support and Node.js-only Sentry integration — custom logger wrapper is correct choice for a zero-knowledge app needing sensitive field stripping
.planning/ROADMAP.md and .planning/codebase/ were not in .markdownlintignore, causing the linter to escape asterisks (e.g. console.*) which broke gsd-tools.cjs JSON parsing
All v1.1 phases (18-27) are complete; new phases start at 28
unenrollIpns() API endpoint already exists for IPNS orphan cleanup — just needs to be wired up
useSharedNavigation.ts is 1199 lines with zero unit tests — identified as highest-risk fragile area

code.finding: deleteTestAccount() helper calls DELETE /auth/account with { confirmation: 'DELETE' } but is only used in recovery.spec.ts
Uses import.meta.env.DEV for gating and has a DEV-only global error capture that should remain as-is during logger migration
34 console.* calls (largest offender); contains coreKit: any and loginParams: any that could use Web3AuthMPCCoreKit type from core-kit.ts
Only excluded .planning/phases/ and .planning/milestones/ — needed to also exclude .planning/*.md and .planning/codebase/ to prevent linter from escaping special chars in planning docs

workflow: GSD STATE.md todo counts can go stale across sessions — always verify actual file count before computing deltas rather than reading the stored number
The gsd-tools.cjs init manager command fails if ROADMAP.md contains markdown-escaped characters like \* — markdownlint must be configured to ignore planning docs
When adding phases requiring discuss-first, Phase 28 (logger) should complete before Phase 30 (observability) since observability hooks into the logger transport array
GSD assumptions mode is effective for mechanical phases — surfaced all 5 concern areas with evidence and only needed one research detour (pino vs custom wrapper) before user confirmed

friction: STATE.md had a stale todo count (showed 10 before session, was actually 6) causing incorrect arithmetic — reported 6→14 when actual was 6→10

markdownlint escaped console.* to console.\* in ROADMAP.md after commit, breaking gsd-tools.cjs JSON parsing of the manager init command — required a separate fix commit and .markdownlintignore update
gsd-tools init manager returned parse errors multiple times before the ROADMAP.md escaping issue was identified and resolved
open_items: Phase 28 context captured but not yet planned or executed — /gsd:plan-phase 28 is next step
Phases 29 (Infrastructure Hardening) and 32 (FUSE Async FilePointer) are ready to plan immediately and can run in parallel with 28
Phases 30 (Web App Observability) and 31 (Structural Decomposition) blocked on Phase 28 completion
6 E2E todos captured: shared deleteAccount teardown, media preview suite, AES-CTR streaming suite, batch download suite, staging metrics baselines, BYO-IPFS load test baselines
Link/unlink auth methods E2E deferred to full-lifecycle flow test rather than standalone spec
TEE IPNS republishing, pin migration, and Prometheus metrics noted as integration/smoke tests rather than E2E candidates
